before.clinician_review: Nataliia Ignatenko: Dipl. ECVIM-CA (Oncology), head of oncology/radiation service. Residents Nicole Dollansky and Stefanie Schaich-Willmertinger are retained as residents. Vassiliki Kanellopoulos is a medical physicist, not assigned a veterinary oncology board.
before.availability_note: Dogs and cats; oncology appointments by telephone/email. Current new LMU site explicitly announces resumed radiation and supersedes the old paused-service page. Current radiation is restricted mainly to selected superficial tumors, operative beds, rostral oral lesions and limb palliation; no current treatment of brain, thorax, spine, pelvis, neck or most deep head tumors. No stereotactic/linear-accelerator capability inferred from generic educational PDF.

before.name: Tierarztpraxis Am Westend
before.coordinate_source: Exact branch address verified from official contact source; building coordinates remain unverified and are not estimated.
before.clinician_review: Sven Stahlhut: veterinarian/owner, surgery and oncology focus. Current team also lists Diana Schulenburg, Fachtierärztin für Innere Medizin beim Kleintier, GPCert Oncology. Her biography dates previous Kleintierspezialisten employment to 2017–2025. No oncology diplomate title inferred.
before.availability_note: Dogs and cats; general service list explicitly offers oncology including chemotherapy. Prior appointment by telephone/online/Moosepet; bring previous reports. Small-mammal care is severely restricted because of staff allergies; birds, reptiles and exotics referred elsewhere. Current overlapping Schulenburg rosters are documented, not resolved by assuming a clinic closure. The current announcement closes the practice on 12–17 October 2026 and announces reopening on 19 October at Heerstraße 18–20, 14052 Berlin; telephone and email remain unchanged. Confirm the location when booking.
